================================================================================
Closed range with a parenthesized lower bound in a case
================================================================================

func f(_ n: Int) {
  switch n {
  case (1 + 2)...10:
    break
  default:
    break
  }
}

================================================================================
Half-open range from an implicit member in a case
================================================================================

func f(_ n: Int) {
  switch n {
  case .min..<0:
    break
  default:
    break
  }
}
